title: Add read-only subtitle QA evidence
summary: Adds backend-authored read-only subtitle QA evidence packets to Queue and Completed rows, exposes dedicated subtitle QA summary/item/preview API routes, and surfaces the evidence in Queue detail, Completed table evidence, and Completed proof walkthroughs.
reason: Operators need subtitle correctness, conversion/OCR evidence, and sync risk to be visible before trust, rerun, cleanup, pending-publish, or sample-validation decisions.
behavior_before: Queue and Completed rows showed subtitle decision counts/previews, but there was no backend-authored QA packet for subtitle inventory, generated SRT evidence, OCR/conversion evidence, policy-language hints, or sync-review risk.
behavior_after: Queue and Completed rows include subtitle_qa evidence using subtitle_qa_result.v1 with inventory, policy-match hint, SRT validity status, coverage heuristics, conversion/OCR evidence, sync-review status, safe next action, and read-only guardrails. New GET /api/subtitle-qa/summary, GET /api/subtitle-qa/item, and POST /api/subtitle-qa/preview routes expose that evidence without probing or mutating media. WebView Queue and Completed proof surfaces display backend QA posture and guidance.
rollback_plan: Remove the core/subtitles QA module and facade mixin, remove subtitle_qa row annotations, remove the /api/subtitle-qa read/preview routes and contracts, revert the WebView subtitle QA display additions, restore the row-detail smoke wrapper PYTHONPATH change if not otherwise needed, and delete the focused subtitle QA test.
notes: Implementation is evidence-only. It does not run ffprobe, OCR, conversion, sync estimation, repair, rerun, publish, drain, rewrite manifests, or touch media files. Existing generated SRT structural validity is reported only when cue evidence already exists in backend decision records; otherwise the QA packet says not_checked.
